observations: Metallic automotive alternator with a ribbed pulley and cooling fins.
The unit shows significant surface dirt and grime, suggesting it has been used.
A black rubber or plastic cap is visible on the center of the pulley in photo 1.

claims.claim: deals on all kinds of cars spare parts
claims.evidence: The seller's business scope cannot be confirmed from a single photo of an alternator.

risks.risk: The alternator may be electrically non-functional or have internal faults.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter test of the output voltage while the unit is powered.

risks.risk: The alternator may be a generic or third-party unit rather than a specific OEM part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label or part number stamped on the housing.

risks.risk: The pulley may be damaged or the bearings may be seized.
risks.proof: A video of the pulley spinning freely by hand.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the alternator spinning by hand to check the pulley and bearings.
Video showing a multimeter test of the output voltage to verify it is functional.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
